entries.name: Elementalists
entries.description: Learned natural philosophers, physicians and theurgists who work the four elements through Techniques of Summoning, Controlling, Divining and Refining, each of a medicinal, philosophical or theurgical type. They gather in societies such as the Apostles of Apollonius, the Ikhwan as-Safa' and the Tulab Ibn Sina, each of which favors two Techniques and all four Forms.
entries.notes: The Forms are Difficult Arts; the Techniques are normal Arts, and the three types of a Technique (Medicinal, Philosophical, Theurgical) share the one Technique Art, and the Virtues say which types the elementalist may use. Each society opens and favors its own two Techniques besides the four Forms (Apostles: Theurgical Summoning and Controlling; Ikhwan: Philosophical Summoning and Refining; Tulab: Medicinal Summoning and Divining). Refining uses Medicine, Philosophiae or the (Realm) Lore of its target's realm. Elemental Warping gives a Personality Trait per Form (Warping Score + Form / 5). Only matching elemental vis may be used, +2 per pawn; Ikhwan training gives 30 xp a year and Tulab 150 xp over 5 years on Academic and Arcane Abilities.

training.notes: No fixed apprenticeship: a society's training is Later Life xp (the Ikhwan's 30 xp a year and the Tulab's 150 xp over five years go on Academic and Arcane Abilities). A Gifted master Opens the society's two Techniques with the Forms; the Technique Virtues give them here.

casting.name: Elemental magic
casting.against: Summoning chart's row for the target
casting.fatigue: Summoning 1 long-term Fatigue level; Controlling 1 short-term; Divining none
casting.vis: Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram vis matching the Form
casting.notes: Several elements at once use the lowest Form. A target bound in its container counts as level 0, the whole total being Penetration.

casting.name: Refining
casting.notes: A season in a workshop. Adds the Ability of the Technique's type: Medicine (Medicinal), Philosophiae (Philosophical) or the target realm's Lore (Theurgical); the best one the character has is shown.

opening.notes: A society Opens its two favored Techniques and all four Forms; the others need initiation. Below 2 in a favored Art, the master gives the student an Elementalist Flaw, such as Deleterious Circumstances or Vulnerable to (Form).

initiation.notes: The Mystagogue's Organization Lore for his society (Ikhwan as-Safa', Tulab Ibn Sina, the Apostles of Apollonius).

scripts.name: Ikhwan: Blood Oath
scripts.gains: Philosophical Refining (Major); then a season with the sponsor for a score of 1
scripts.notes: Every Ikhwan script needs Artes Liberales, Philosophiae and Theology (Islam) 4, and Arabic 5.

scripts.name: Ikhwan: Uncovering the Elemental Nature of Man
scripts.gains: an Elementalist Form at 1, by temperament

scripts.name: Ikhwan: Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable
scripts.notes: Needs a summa of level 3 or more, written by the initiate.

scripts.name: Tulab: Testing the Physician's Dedication
scripts.notes: Medicine and Chirurgy 3 or more.

scripts.name: Tulab: Discovering the Physician's Humor
scripts.notes: Medicine and Chirurgy 4 or more, and a Medium Wound.

scripts.name: Tulab: Improving the Physician's Character
scripts.notes: Medicine and Chirurgy 5 or more.

scripts.name: Tulab: Opening the Mind
scripts.notes: 5 or more in Medicine, Artes Liberales, Arabic, Philosophiae and Theology (Islam); Stamina against 9 each season at the tomb.

advancement.notes: A Form is studied from a stress die + aura, costing pawns of its vis equal to its score; a Technique is practised with one Form, costing half its score (rounded up) in that Form's vis.

activities.label: Refining
activities.summary: A season in a workshop: the Refining Total makes longevity and Characteristic potions, extracts or moves vis, or restores a being's Might.

warping.name: Elemental Warping
warping.trigger: Any rise in the Warping Score, or an Elementalist Form passing a multiple of 5.
warping.notes: In place of new Virtues and Flaws, a Personality Trait per Elementalist Form held: Warping Score + Form / 5 (rounded up). A Trait adds to Soak against its element and is subtracted from Recovery rolls against illnesses of its humor (an opposing Trait adds). At +3 it acts as a Minor Personality Flaw, at +6 a Major one; at +10 the storyguide controls the character wherever it applies.

entries.name: Folk Witches
entries.description: Village wise-women and their covens, who curse, heal, fly, scry and change shape through incantations, fetishes and potions brewed in a kitchen laboratory. They may be Gifted or unGifted, and gather at the eight sabbats of the year.
entries.notes: Must take at least one Flaw affecting their magic. Apprenticeship gives 200 xp (Well-Trained +50, Poorly Trained -50 each); afterwards 15 xp a year, modified by Wealthy or Poor. A witch spends two seasons a year supporting themselves; at creation each lab season costs 10 of that year's xp, at most 2 a year (Wealthy 3, Poor 1). A Gifted apprentice leaves with at least 1 in each of the seven Abilities and in Folk Witch Magic Theory. The troupe may swap in Animal Healing, Entrancement, Enchanting Music, Nightwalking, Premonitions or Wilderness Sense. Organization Lore: Folk Witches recognises a witch's mark.

training.notes: A witch must take at least one Flaw affecting their magic. After apprenticeship they have 15 xp a year (Wealthy or Poor change it), and each lab season at creation costs 10 of that year's xp, at most 2 a year (Wealthy 3, Poor 1).

casting.name: Folk witch powers
casting.vis: the Ability's Form, besides any the effect itself costs
casting.notes: Each power is worked by its Method: Potion (drunk), Incantation (heard) or Fetish (held). A botch gives a Warping Point per 0.

casting.name: Folk witch Lab Total
casting.notes: A season in her kitchen (a standard laboratory). Some work uses no Supernatural Ability: then Int + Folk Witch Magic Theory + aura.

Animal Ken.against: effects cast by casters in animal form

Cursing.against: effects cast through an Arcane Connection

groups.name: Sabbat
groups.notes: At one of the eight sabbats: +1 per assisting witch who has the potion's Ability (Brew Potency), per assisting Gifted witch (Opening), or per assisting witch with the granted Ability (Initiation). Each witch joins one activity per sabbat.

opening.notes: A sabbat Opening adds +1 for each assisting Gifted witch, up to the aura.

initiation.notes: The Mystagogue must know the Ability she grants. A sabbat adds +1 for each assisting witch who has it, up to the aura.

scripts.name: Venomous Darts
scripts.notes: Winter only.

scripts.name: Hands of Life
scripts.notes: Spring only.

advancement.notes: Her powers are Supernatural Abilities on the Ability table, practised like any Ability. After apprenticeship, 15 xp a year.

activities.label: Brew a potion or make a fetish
activities.summary: A season in her kitchen: a potion, a fetish, or a curse worked into a fetish, by the Lab Total of one of her powers.

activities.label: Bind a familiar
activities.summary: A season: her Animal Ken Lab Total must exceed 10 + the animal's Size + its Magic Might.

warping.name: The Witch Moon
warping.trigger: Each rise in the Warping Score.
warping.notes: A month (at least) without her Supernatural Abilities, with a fever that gives a Medium Wound. At each month's end, Stamina - Warping Score + stress die vs 6 ends it; a failure adds a Warping Point and another month, a botch Warping Points equal to its 0s. More months than her Warping Score is a bad experience (lost xp, a Minor Flaw), otherwise a good one (5 xp per month, a Minor Virtue, or a new Supernatural Ability at 1). A botch with a Supernatural Ability gives a Warping Point per 0.

bonds.name: Familiar
bonds.how: A season's lab work: her Animal Ken Lab Total must exceed 10 + the animal's Size + its Magic Might. One familiar at a time.
bonds.feeds: Her Lab Totals: the familiar's Intelligence + its Folk Witch Magic Theory.
bonds.notes: Both gain True Friend and Loyal +3; the familiar gains human Intelligence (-3 if it had none) and her languages, ages only when she does, and each is an Arcane Connection to the other with no Magic Resistance between them.

entries.name: Gruagachan
entries.description: Pictish wizards of the Scottish Highlands, whose Techniques Give and Take and Forms Blessing, Curse, Shape and Vision work spells of blessing, cursing, transformation and illusion, and who enchant tattoos. Their branches include the Norse trollsynir and the Slavic kolduni.
entries.notes: Give and Take are Difficult Arts. Pictish caps every gruagach Art (5 at Pictish 1, 15 at 2, 30 at 3, no limit from 4), and Arts cannot be practised. A Gifted apprenticeship gives 160 xp and 80 spell levels and leaves at least Pictish 2, Gruagach Lore 2 and 1 in every Art; an unGifted one 16 xp and 8 spell levels a year, and needs Giant Blood, Large or Shapeshifter. Gruagach Lore is their Organization Lore. Trollsynir use Jotnar (the Jotun language) in place of Pictish and must take Giant Blood and No Tattoo Magic; kolduni use Koldovali Theory, must take No Tattoo Magic, and also favor Animal Ken and Mythic Herbalism. Gruagachan support themselves for an unstated part of the year.

training.notes: An unGifted apprentice trains 3 to 5 years at 16 xp and 8 spell levels a year; the worksheet allows 4 years. An unGifted gruagach needs Giant Blood, Large or Shapeshifter, and a Technique and a Form Virtue.

casting.name: Formulaic spell
casting.vis: Give as Creo or Rego, Take as Intellego, Rego or Perdo; the Forms as Corpus, Mentem, Muto, Imaginem or Vim
casting.resistance: Give Curse, Take Blessing and Take Shape: Stamina + stress die against 9, -6 to +9 by Poetic Justice
casting.notes: May vary one of Range, Duration, Target or size by up to 2 magnitudes (Flexible Gruagach Magic 3, Inflexible Magic 1). Spells need a voice; no Rituals, no Ceremonial casting.

casting.name: Spontaneous spell
casting.fatigue: always 1 Fatigue level

casting.name: Gruagach Lab Total
casting.notes: Inventing spells and enchanting tattoos. Pictish serves as the tradition's Magic Theory.

dispels.name: Remove his own curse
dispels.notes: the spell's level + a stress die; failing, he suffers the curse too

dispels.name: Remove another's curse or continuing spell
dispels.notes: the spell's level + a stress die

dispels.name: Revert a transformation
dispels.notes: the spell's level + a stress die; his own transformation needs only its level

dispels.name: Dispel an illusion
dispels.notes: the spell's level + a stress die

opening.notes: The master's Give Vision Lab Total.

initiation.notes: A self-initiation uses his own scores and the higher Ease Factor. UnGifted scripts come in any order, never self-initiated.

scripts.name: Calling the Fetch
scripts.ordeal: Restriction: no magic on the fetch's kind of animal
scripts.notes: 18 self-initiated. Three consecutive Stamina + Concentration rolls against 9.

scripts.name: Extraction of the Soul
scripts.notes: 30 self-initiated. After Calling the Fetch.

scripts.name: Give
scripts.gains: Give 1, after two seasons with the master

scripts.name: Vision
scripts.notes: Three consecutive Stamina + Concentration rolls against 9.

advancement.notes: An oral tradition: the Arts improve by teaching, vis study, Exposure and adventure, not practice. Pictish caps each Art: 1 -> 5, 2 -> 15, 3 -> 30.

activities.label: Invent a gruagach spell
activities.summary: A season inventing a spell, by the Gruagach Lab Total of its Technique and Form.

activities.label: Enchant a tattoo
activities.summary: A season inking a tattoo designed for its bearer, by the Gruagach Lab Total.

warping.name: Transformation
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from one botch, or another powerful magical effect.
warping.notes: Avoid it: Stamina + Concentration + Vision Magic Defense bonus + stress die vs Warping Score + Warping Points gained + aura + stress die. If not avoided, Intelligence + stress die vs Warping Score + stress die says whether the experience is good (understanding of his magic) or bad (a troll's trait). At Warping Score 10 he is a troll, played by the storyguide. External Soul gives a Warping Point a year.

bonds.name: Fetch
bonds.how: The Fetch Virtue (from the Ritual of Calling the Fetch, an Initiation) gives constant access to it; without it, only through Vision magic.
bonds.feeds: Nothing to his totals: an invisible animal spirit with Second Sight 9 that warns him of danger.
bonds.notes: He may never use magic on the kind of beast his fetch is.

entries.name: Learned Magicians
entries.description: Scholarly mathematici trained at Bologna and elsewhere, who cast charms and make amulets and chartae with the Techniques Tueor, Succurro and Vulnero and the Forms Fortunam, Magicam and Salutem, aided by astrology. Mythic alchemists and cunning-folk are variant branches.
entries.notes: The three Techniques are Difficult Arts. Opening gives all six Arts at 0 and Entreat the Powers. Each year under a master gives 30 xp on Arcane and Academic Abilities and the Arts, with charms bought at 5 levels per xp (Skilled Master +50, Poorly Trained Magician -50). Latin 1 is needed to learn charms and Artes Liberales 1 to make devices; they cannot study from vis. Lore of the Mathematici is their Organization Lore. Mythic alchemists require Mythic Alchemy, Laboratory Magician and No Text Casting and use Philosophiae in their Lab Total, and also favor Natural Magician and Mythic Herbalism; cunning-folk require Mythic Herbalism and Entreat the Faerie Powers, use Craft: Charm, and also favor Purifying Touch and Premonitions.

training.notes: Each year under a master gives 30 xp on Arcane and Academic Abilities and the Arts, with charms at 5 levels per xp (Skilled Master +50, Poorly Trained Magician -50); the book sets no length, so spend it as Later Life xp. Only a Gifted master can Open the Arts; an unGifted member is initiated.

casting.name: Known charm
casting.vis: Tueor as Rego, Succurro as Creo, Vulnero as Perdo, Fortunam and Magicam as Vim, Salutem as Corpus, Herbam, Animal or Mentem
casting.notes: A stress die when under pressure. Strong and Weak Verbal Charms change the divisor. No spontaneous charms.

casting.name: Charm from a text
casting.notes: 2 minutes a magnitude to read (x2 below Language 4, x4 at 2 or less); +1 botch die per point of Language below 5.

casting.name: Learned magician Lab Total
casting.notes: Inventing charms and making amulets and chartae.

Magicam.against: Vim effects cast on his charms

dispels.name: Shorten a continuing effect
dispels.notes: the charm's level + a stress die + 10 must reach twice the effect's Casting Total; it drops one Duration step

opening.notes: The master's Succurro Magicam Lab Total. UnGifted students are initiated instead.

initiation.notes: Each script is a season of service testing an Ability at 2 or more, and a season of teaching. The book prints no Initiation Total; this is the usual Mystery one.

scripts.name: Tueor
scripts.notes: Tests Philosophiae 2.

scripts.name: Fortunam
scripts.notes: Tests Theology 2.

scripts.name: Magicam
scripts.notes: Tests Magic Lore 2.

scripts.name: Salutem
scripts.ordeal: No Magical Defenses, Incompatible Hedge Arts (Vulnero Salutem)
scripts.notes: Tests Medicine 2.

scripts.name: Entreat the Divine Powers
scripts.notes: Tests Divine Lore 2.

advancement.notes: Books on their Arts use the usual rules; they may not study from vis.

activities.label: Invent a charm
activities.summary: A season inventing a charm, by the Lab Total of its Technique and Form.

activities.label: Make an amulet or charta
activities.summary: A season making an amulet (charges by the Lab Total) or a charta.

warping.name: Intervention and Abduction
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from a botch.
warping.notes: Avoid it: Intelligence + Concentration + Magicam / 5 + stress die vs Warping Score + Warping Points gained + (Realm) aura + stress die. If not avoided, appease the entity: Communication + stress die vs Warping Score + stress die; success may bring a boon, failure a punishment (lost charms for a time, or abduction to a regio). At Warping Score 10 the loss is permanent.

entries.name: Nightwalkers
entries.description: UnGifted folk such as the benandanti, the Hounds of God, kresniki, kudlaki and taltós, whose spirits leave their sleeping bodies to fight the fertility battles that decide the harvest. Their powers come from Virtues, not Arts.
entries.notes: Nightwalkers are ordinary unGifted companions; membership of a regional tradition is a Free Virtue, and they take an ordinary mundane Social Status. Losing the caul may be taken as a Major Story Flaw: the nightwalker's powers are gone until it is regained. Straying has no Ability score and does not improve. Their Second Sight works only in phantastic form. Usually four fertility battles a year, whose outcome can set the covenant's income roll. Hamr and Sleepwalker are lesser alternatives to the Nightwalker Virtue.

casting.name: Spirit travel
casting.fatigue: 1 long-term Fatigue level an hour, 2 for a whole night
casting.notes: Ease Factor 3 (places seen daily) to 15 (never visited), +3 per non-tradition object carried.

advancement.notes: Nightwalkers advance as ordinary companions; their spirit travel is a Virtue's power, not an Art.

entries.name: Vitkir
entries.description: Norse rune wizards who carve the 24 runes of the Elder Futhark into scripts whose effects are true, natural changes that last as long as the inscription. Every vitki has The Gift, and their runes advance as Accelerated Abilities.
entries.notes: About 15 years' apprenticeship gives 240 xp (at least half on runes) and 120 levels of rune scripts, plus 50 xp for the minimums Craft: Runes 2, Old Norse 3 and Rune Magic 1; no rune above 10 on leaving. A vitki taught by a master gets one free Minor Vitkar Virtue of the master's specialty. Runes may be studied from vis of any Art. Craft: Runes is an instance of the Craft Ability. Odin's Sacrifice, once a lifetime, can grant The Gift or open the runes.

training.notes: 240 xp, at least half on runes, and 120 levels of rune scripts, plus 50 xp for the minimum scores (counted in the 290 here). The free Minor Vitkar Virtue is of the master's specialty. A master below 2 in a rune leaves the student a Minor Magical Deficiency.

casting.name: Rune script
casting.vis: a Technique or Form fitting the effect or target
casting.notes: A script uses the lowest of its runes. Hidden name -2, no name -5, hidden description -5, no description -10, extra effort +1, emphasis +1.

casting.name: Vitkar Lab Total
casting.notes: Needs no laboratory. A season's invention gives spell levels equal to the Lab Total, split among scripts of those runes.

opening.notes: A master in Nátt-thel (or who lost his Gift to it) can still Open, but the student also gains Nátt-thel Prone. After about five years with one master, the student gains a Minor Virtue of the master's specialty.

advancement.notes: Runes are studied as magi study the Arts: books, teaching, adventure, Exposure, and vis of any Art, brewed with mead and blood.

activities.label: Invent rune scripts
activities.summary: A season: spell levels equal to the Vitkar Lab Total, split among scripts of those runes.

warping.name: Nátt-thel
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from a single event.
warping.notes: Avoid it: Stamina + Concentration + stress die vs Warping Score x 3. If not avoided, his runes end and he loses The Gift and his vitkar Virtues and Flaws for a time: simple die + Warping Score gives the unit (0 Moments, 3 Diameters, 6 Suns, 9 Moons, 12 Years, 15 longer), times the Warping Points gained. He may keep rune scripts going for a further Warping Point each.

entries.name: Ollamhain
entries.description: Irish poets, sages and performers who claim kinship with the Fair Folk and hide faerie rites in their songs and poems, often played on enchanted harps handed down in families. They excel at the Method Enchantment and the Powers Beguile, Dream and Portage.
entries.notes: A starting rite-caster spends at least 4 Virtue points on a Faerie Method and a Faerie Power (one Major Method and one Minor Power is the least), and needs Sympathy Traits from Virtues or Flaws (Faerie Sympathy, Faerie Background, Faerie Antipathy) or a high Warping Score. Any Method works with any Power; neither works alone. A member initiated into the tradition learns its four favored Abilities without subtracting his other Supernatural scores and without the Faerie Rank limit; any other faerie Ability needs his strongest positive plus strongest negative Sympathy Trait to be at least 5 at the start of the season. Many have Faerie Blood. Sympathy Traits rise with xp (5 xp a season of practice), capped by the Warping Score. Faerie auras do not Warp them.

training.notes: No apprenticeship numbers are printed. At creation, at least 4 Virtue points on a Faerie Method and a Faerie Power, plus Sympathy Traits. Faerie Sympathy or Faerie Background lets the Warping Score be raised freely at creation.

casting.name: Faerie rite
casting.fatigue: Enchantment: a performance roll against 3 x the magnitude first; Evocation: a Warping Point or a Confidence Point; Empathy: a Fatigue level and about an hour's trance
casting.vis: Only with Evocation: any vis, up to Evocation + the Power in pawns; each non-Faerie pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: The total (Method's Characteristic + Method + Power + Faerie aura + stress die) is the level of the effect made. The most it can reach is 5 x the applicable Sympathy Traits (negatives counted as positive). Enchantment may hide any rite in a performance and may roll a simple die (no botch, no Trait change). A 1 on the die gives +1 xp in each Trait used, a botch -1 xp; negative Traits add botch dice. Rituals take 15 minutes a magnitude and need no vis; no rite is permanent. Each Power has a chosen vulnerability that dispels it. Faerie Ranges, Durations and Targets (Presence, Geas, Symbol...) are available.

groups.name: Faerie Ceremony
groups.notes: The focus character must have Ceremony, and for a Power everyone performs the Method. Each participant adds Characteristic + the Ability (or Method), or the Characteristic alone if he lacks it, and the focus also adds the sum of everyone's Ceremony less the number taking part (it may be negative). The book sets no limit on participants (99 stands for none). All count as casters.

advancement.notes: Methods and Powers are Supernatural Abilities on the Ability table, learned like a Gifted character's Supernatural Abilities. Faerie Initiation Scripts exist but are rare: most learn from a teacher.

warping.name: Faerie Calling
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points at once, for a character with a Faerie Rank.
warping.notes: To act during it: Perception + Awareness + stress die vs 3 x (Warping Score + Warping Points gained). To resolve it: Perception + Concentration + stress die vs 3 x (Warping Score - Faerie Rank); above it, a new +1 Trait or +1 to a Trait, otherwise a new -1 Trait or -1 to a Trait. Faerie Rank 10+ on a positive result, or -10 or lower on a negative one, and he becomes a faerie for good. His rites of level 30+ Warp their target, and each 0 on a botch die with a Faerie power gives him a Warping Point.

entries.name: Volkhvy
entries.description: Russian pagan faerie wizards beyond the reach of the Church, whose great communal rites call on their faerie gods for glamours and blessings suited to a harsh wilderness. They excel at the Method Evocation, at Ceremony, and at the Powers Conjure and Grant.
entries.notes: A starting rite-caster spends at least 4 Virtue points on a Faerie Method and a Faerie Power, and needs Sympathy Traits from Virtues or Flaws or a high Warping Score. Any Method works with any Power. A member initiated into the tradition learns its four favored Abilities without subtracting his other Supernatural scores and without the Faerie Rank limit. Many are Self-Confident. Sympathy Traits rise with xp (5 xp a season of practice), capped by the Warping Score. Faerie auras do not Warp them.

entries.name: Wise Folk
entries.description: Faerie-touched wise men and wise women living on the edge of village life, sought out in trouble and feared for their powers. They keep the supernatural at bay, protect those in their care, and heal or harm as they judge fit, through the Method Empathy and the Powers Ware, Weal and Woe.

These are the folk magi usually mean by 'hedge wizard'. Sympathy Traits rise with xp (5 xp a season of practice), capped by the Warping Score. Faerie auras do not Warp them.

Faerie Rank 10+ on a positive result, or -10 or lower on a negative one, and he becomes a faerie for good. His rites of level 30+ Warp their target, and each 0 on a botch die with a Faerie power gives him a Warping Point.

entries.name: Borrowers
entries.description: Wandering traders in exotic goods who make their living selling novelties to faeries in return for faerie blessings, through the Ars Fabulosa: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating and Dismissing. They take children bargained away from faeries as apprentices.
entries.notes: A starting bargainer needs one of the four Ars Fabulosa Virtues, usually (Faerie) Summoning, and Sympathy Traits or a high Warping Score. The Ars Fabulosa start at 0, advance on the Art table, and are practised and studied as Supernatural Abilities; they affect only faeries. The most Might (or effect level) any of them can touch is 5 x the applicable Sympathy Traits (negatives counted as positive). A struck bargain gives +1 xp in a fitting Trait, a failed one -1 xp; bargains bind the faerie absolutely, and a summoner who breaks one gains a -3 Trait. Working out what an unknown faerie wants: Intelligence + Faerie Lore vs 12+; a quick bargain is Communication + Bargain + Faerie Rank, contested. Faerie auras do not Warp them.

training.notes: No apprenticeship numbers are printed. Apprentices serve their master in the trade, learn to bargain and deal with faeries, and are then initiated into the Ars Fabulosa. At creation, one Ars Fabulosa Virtue (usually (Faerie) Summoning) and Sympathy Traits.

casting.name: Summoning
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level (impossible without it); a few minutes
casting.notes: Adds Faerie Rank and the Faerie aura. A faerie always comes (a botch brings a hostile, unbound or wrong one). With an Arcane Connection the total must penetrate or it may ignore him; without one the storyguide picks a faerie of Might up to the value chosen. If the total reaches its Might and penetrates, it is held: it must listen and cannot attack or use powers on him. Penetration adds his highest applicable Trait.

casting.name: Bonding
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level
casting.notes: Adds Faerie Rank and the Faerie aura; the faerie must be within voice range, and the total must exceed its Might and penetrate (a held faerie counts as level 0 for Penetration). The bond is an Arcane Connection and gives one benefit: shared Characteristics or senses, use of its powers from its Might, a stored spell or power, or a season's immunity to Faerie-aura Warping, deprivation, Fatigue penalties and Aging rolls. One bond at a time.

casting.name: Captivating
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level
casting.notes: Adds Faerie Rank and the Faerie aura; voice range; must exceed the faerie's Might and penetrate. He and the faerie swap bodies; each keeps Personality Traits and Confidence, he keeps his Sympathy Traits. His body gains a Warping Point a season and one a year; both are immune to Faerie Calling meanwhile.

casting.name: Dismissing
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level
casting.notes: Adds Faerie Rank and the Faerie aura; he must speak with the being. Cancels an effect of a being with Might, ends effects on such a being, or releases one from an agreement (exceed its Might). He may deflect a power before it acts by beating its Initiative on Quickness + Finesse (+ his highest Trait if he has Finesse), several a round at a cumulative -6. Breaking his own bargains this way costs no Sympathy.

dispels.name: Dismiss a power's effect
dispels.notes: The Dismissing Total must exceed the effect's level and penetrate; works on effects of beings with a Might Score.

advancement.notes: The Ars Fabulosa advance on the Art table but are practised and studied as Supernatural Abilities.

bonds.name: Bonded faerie
bonds.how: A Bonding Total that exceeds the faerie's Might and penetrates, with the faerie in voice range; costs a Fatigue level. One bond at a time; a bond to an object needs a daily charm.
bonds.feeds: One benefit: shared Characteristics or senses; use of its powers from its Might pool; a stored spell or power the bearer can trigger; or a season's immunity to Faerie-aura Warping, deprivation, Fatigue penalties and Aging rolls.
bonds.notes: The bond is an Arcane Connection between the faerie and its bearer (him or a touched object). A stored effect is used as if he cast it, paying his costs but skipping the die; its Penetration is the faerie's Might less the effect's level.

entries.name: Faerie Doctors
entries.description: Go-betweens for peasants and the fae in Saxon lands (also called lybmen), who keep local faerie tales alive, mediate disputes, cure blights and diseases by Curse-Throwing and find water and lost things by Dowsing. Taught from birth by a relative, they finish training when they gain a faerie companion.
entries.notes: Every faerie doctor takes Wise One, Curse-Throwing, Faerie Friend and Dutybound (to the doctor's oaths: neutrality between humans and faeries, often also uncut hair, no beard, women's clothes or celibacy). As a Mythic Companion (the Faerie Doctor Virtue) he gets Dowsing free and 2 Virtue points per Flaw point, at most 21 Virtue points for 10 Flaw points, with minimum Abilities Curse-Throwing 4, Dowsing 1, Faerie Lore 3, Profession: Storyteller 1 (DE); this is incompatible with The Gift. Otherwise he balances Virtues and Flaws normally. A Gifted doctor takes one Supernatural Ability without its Virtue (usually Curse-Throwing), and his favored Abilities do not lower the Source Quality for learning each other, though non-favored Supernatural Abilities still do. Sin-eaters use Curse-Throwing on the sins of the dying (a Minor, Serious or Major Affliction, EF 9/12/15), which keeps the dead from becoming ghosts. Common extras: Student of Faerie, Faerie Upbringing, an Immunity, Rapid Convalescence, (Faerie) Summoning, Herbalism, Purifying Touch, Second Sight.

training.notes: Trained from birth by a relative, usually an uncle; the apprenticeship ends when he gains his faerie companion (Faerie Friend). No xp is printed. A Gifted doctor gets one Supernatural Ability without its Virtue.

casting.name: Curse-Throwing
casting.fatigue: A ritual of an hour per 5 points (or part) of the Ease Factor
casting.notes: Ease Factor: 9 minor disease or affliction, 12 serious (or like a Minor Flaw), 15 major (or like a Major Flaw), 18 critical disease; 12 + magnitude for a spell, 12 + score for a Supernatural Ability, 12 + Might points spent for a creature's power. Recipient by Arcane Connection: -1 lasting decades, -3 months or years, -6 weeks or less; -3 if of another species. Penetration is the total - the Ease Factor + Penetration bonus, against the sufferer's or recipient's Magic Resistance. Harmful effects only, never a permanent Flaw; a botch moves the curse onto him.

bonds.how: Gained around puberty, ending the apprenticeship (the Faerie Friend Flaw).

bonds.notes: Usually a faerie of high cognizance, of any form.

entries.name: Homunculus Wizards
entries.description: Faerie-aligned wizards whose power comes from a homunculus, a tiny faerie between Magic and Faerie bound to them at birth, which gives them a faerie version of The Gift. They can learn Supernatural Abilities and even be Opened to the Hermetic Arts.
entries.notes: Take The Gift and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw (an Ex Miscellanea magus may take it as his inherent Flaw). No talisman or familiar. All his powers are Faerie-aligned: Faerie auras do not Warp him, but Magic auras and Magical Warping do. His Gift acts as the Gentle Gift. Merinita's Faerie Magic outer mystery benefits him. If his homunculus dies he cannot use or improve non-Faerie or Gift-requiring powers until he binds another.

training.notes: Built with The Gift and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw; no tradition apprenticeship is printed.

bonds.name: Homunculus
bonds.how: A newborn homunculus bonds for life to the first person it sees, and must be fed a little of his blood in secret every day.
bonds.feeds: His Gift: it turns its glamour into the semblance of Magic, letting him learn Supernatural Abilities and be Opened to the Arts.
bonds.notes: If it is harmed or any other human sees it, it dies at once, and he loses his non-Faerie and Gift-requiring powers until he binds a new one.

entries.name: Caerfloron's Line
entries.description: Ex Miscellanea magi descended from Caerfloron, Homunculus Wizards whose manikin is made from a Mandrake of Virtue taken on a single visit to Hérisson's Garden at the start of training. Like plants they draw on daylight and need no food, drink or air.
entries.notes: The tradition brings Greater Immunity (Deprivation), Faerie Magic and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw; the book does not say whether these are free or bought normally. All share Disfigured (green-tinged skin and hair). Long-term Fatigue still needs rest and food to recover. Despite Faerie Magic they cannot be initiated into Merinita's Inner Mysteries. Each vows never to enter the Garden a second time.

training.notes: Hermetic apprenticeship as for any magus; the mandrake is taken from Hérisson's Garden once, at the start of training.

bonds.name: Mandrake homunculus

entries.name: Wordsmiths
entries.description: Irish storytellers and poets touched by a realm, usually Faerie, who craft wondrous tales and poems: told aloud, the tale works its magic for the one person it was made for.
entries.notes: Needs Touched by (Realm), usually Faerie. A tale is made like a wondrous item but with Communication + Profession: Storyteller (or Poet) in place of Dexterity + Craft. Helpers give the usual assistant bonus; shape and material bonuses for things central to the tale count half, rounded up. Range Personal, Duration Performance (as Concentration, +1 magnitude), Target Sound (as Structure, +3) are fixed. Only the person it was made for can use it; copies carry no magic; reciting it makes an Arcane Connection to the reciter.

training.notes: No apprenticeship is printed.

activities.label: Compose a wondrous tale
activities.summary: A season composing a magical story or poem for one person, by the wondrous-tale Workshop Total.

entries.name: Ascetics
entries.description: Holy men and women of any faith who starve the flesh to feed the soul, live by a strict rule, see through illusion to the spirits beyond, and drive out evil. The book's generic holy tradition.
entries.notes: Any faith. Most Christian ascetics follow a monastic rule; vows of obedience and humility are usual.

training.notes: The book gives no apprenticeship: build the member as a normal character, buying the tradition's Methods and Powers as Major Supernatural Virtues (Ability 1). With True Faith they may also be learned by study. Traditions teach Dominion Lore, Finesse and Penetration besides.

entries.description: Nubian exorcists of the Mortuary Society who lay the restless dead with wards and rites sprinkled with Kassalan Dust, and strip ghosts of their power.

warping.trigger: Two or more Warping Points at once from Infernal power (a failed maleficium, a botched Goetic Art).
warping.notes: The Infernal counterpart of Twilight (RoP: The Infernal); a Gifted member with The False Gift has it in place of Twilight.

entries.name: Ba'al Ov
entries.description: Jewish necromancers who call up, command and bind spirits of the dead with the Infernal Goetic Arts, using corpses and skulls in place of circles.
entries.notes: Not a holy tradition. Corpses, skulls or participants serve as receptacles in place of a summoning circle, and the same objects are permanent Binding vessels. The book names no favored Abilities. Favored Abilities are learned with no study penalty and are not subtracted when learning other Infernal Supernatural Abilities; a character gets favored Abilities from one Infernal tradition in a lifetime. Any other Infernal Supernatural Ability is learned as a core Supernatural Ability (other Supernatural scores subtract from the Source Quality; score 1 in the first season). Anyone touched by the Infernal may learn them. Each Ability may also be bought as its Virtue at creation. A character with the No Tradition Flaw has no favored Abilities.

training.notes: The book gives no apprenticeship. Members are built as companions (favored Abilities bought as their Virtues), as Mythic Companions with the Diabolist or Summoner Virtue, or as magi; later Infernal Abilities are learned with no penalty if favored. Each Goetic Art is opened at 0 by its Virtue and then advanced as an Art.

casting.name: Goetic Art
casting.fatigue: Summoning always costs a Fatigue level
casting.notes: Characteristic + the Art + the Lore of the target's realm (Area Lore when Scouring) + aura + Penetration x its Arcane Connection multiplier, + the caster's Hierarchy x 5 against a demon. Target level: the spirit's Might in a circle, twice its Might outside one, + the demon's Hierarchy x 5. Summoning needs the total to reach twice Might to hold the spirit in the circle; between Might and twice Might it stays only while he concentrates. Sacrifice adds. Penetration is already inside the total. Ablating, Binding and Commanding are always Infernal; Summoning may count as Magic or Faerie.

advancement.notes: Methods, Powers and other Supernatural Abilities advance on the Ability table; Goetic Arts on the Art table, from books, teachers and practice. Favored Abilities carry no study penalty.

activities.label: Prepare a binding anchor
activities.summary: A season preparing an object to hold a bound spirit, then a Binding total to seal it in.

bonds.name: Bound spirit
bonds.how: A Binding total above the spirit's Might in a circle (twice its Might outside, its Might if it doesn't resist), sealing it into an object or a person.
bonds.feeds: The bearer gets Magic Resistance equal to its Might; an object holds Might x 5 levels of Infernal effects and Vim vis up to its Might; a host buys Abilities it shares as with an Affinity, halves the penalty learning its Supernatural Abilities and may learn its Powers.
bonds.notes: A host makes no Aging rolls but gains a Warping Point a year, an Infernal Reputation of the demon's Hierarchy, and its Personality Traits. Preparing an object anchor takes a season.

warping.name: Vituperation
warping.trigger: Two or more Warping Points at once from Infernal power (a failed maleficium, a botched Goetic Art).
warping.notes: The Infernal counterpart of Twilight (RoP: The Infernal); a Gifted member with The False Gift has it in place of Twilight.

entries.name: Beast Masters
entries.description: Magi Ex Miscellanea who call animals to them with a cry or whistle and keep a close bond with the beasts of one kind.
entries.notes: Package: Summon Animals (Major non-Hermetic), Inoffensive to Animals (Minor Hermetic), Study Requirement (Major Hermetic Flaw); also Animal Ken, a Minor Magical Focus in one group of animals, Incompatible Arts (Muto Corpus and Perdo Animal) and at least one more Flaw, then 8 Flaw points for 8 Virtue points. HoH: Societates names Feral Upbringing as that extra Flaw; the Definitive Edition leaves it open. Animals summoned by score: 1 gives one of Size -2 (or 2 of -3, 5 of -4, 10 of -5, 20 of -6), rising to 20 of Size -2 at score 5 (the Societates table uses 3s and 30s where the Definitive Edition uses 2s and 20s). Talking with the animals needs Animal Ken.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea: Hermetic apprenticeship, plus the tradition's free Major non-Hermetic Virtue, free Minor Hermetic Virtue and compulsory Major Hermetic Flaw.

casting.name: Summon Animals
casting.vis: Animal vis, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: Ease Factor 9: the animals arrive within an hour; beat it by 3 for two minutes, by 6 for one round. Needs an audible call and the species' habitat within a day's journey. How many come depends on the score, not the roll. Breaks the Limit of Arcane Connection.

advancement.notes: Summon Animals is a Supernatural Ability on the Ability table (the Virtue gives it at 1); as a Gifted character he may learn other Supernatural Abilities.

entries.name: Tempestaria
entries.description: Saxon weather witches of the House who whistle up winds from a breeze to a hurricane, and must use their tools for every spell.
entries.notes: Package: Whistle Up the Wind (or a similar weather Ability: rain for days, a season with no rain, sea fogs), Affinity with Auram, Necessary Condition (tools). Once raised, a wind can be changed to another of similar strength, weakened or ended with Communication + Music against the Concentration Ease Factors; it cannot be strengthened without a new roll. Every effect drops one strength each sunset until gone.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw.

casting.name: Whistle Up the Wind
casting.vis: Auram vis, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: Copies any wind-making Creo Auram effect at Voice/Individual. Ease Factor 6 light breeze, 9 moderate wind (spoils arrows), 12 strong wind (drives a ship), 15 gale (knocks people over), 18 hurricane (uproots trees). The wind keeps blowing after the whistling stops.

advancement.notes: A Supernatural Ability on the Ability table; the Virtue gives it at 1.

entries.name: Scinnfolk
entries.description: Gifted cunning folk who joined the Order without taking up Hermetic magic: members of House Ex Miscellanea built as Gifted Companions, who bless and blight the fertility of people, beasts and crops.
entries.notes: Built as Gifted Companions: The Gift and Hermetic Magus, then a companion's creation with Arcane Abilities allowed, Parma Magica 1 included in the xp, and the Reputation Hedge Wizard 2 (Hermetic). Control Fertility comes free with The Gift (its Virtue costs nothing here). Their Arts are not opened, and the Supernatural Abilities they hold are their favored Abilities. Common choices: Gentle Gift, Purifying Touch, Student of Magic or Faerie; Visions, Faerie Friend. Score unlocks: 1 keeps minor plant diseases away; 2 doubles or stops an animal's daily yield; 3 +/-3 to Stamina against disease or crop yield +/- half; 4 conception, barrenness or easy childbirth, or +/-1 Living Conditions to Aging (lasting a year); 5 +/-6 to Stamina against disease.

training.notes: Created as a companion, not a magus: no Arts, Parma Magica 1 among the creation xp, Reputation Hedge Wizard 2 (Hermetic). The Gift grants Control Fertility with no other Virtue.

casting.name: Control Fertility
casting.vis: pawns of an Art fitting the effect, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: Ease Factor 9: lasts a month, +1 month per full 3 points over. The target (one person, one animal of Size +2 or the same mass, one tree or a small crop) must be marked, so in effect Touch. A growing season needs at least three months, and the same target can't be affected again until next spring.

advancement.notes: Being Gifted, a Scinnfolk may learn further Supernatural Abilities after creation.

entries.name: Columbae
entries.description: British magi who brought Ring and Circle into Hermetic magic. They draw marked circles that keep out a chosen kind of thing, and must mark the targets of all their spells.
entries.notes: Package: Warding (Major Supernatural, an Accelerated Ability), Ring/Circle Magic, Necessary Condition (mark the target: chalk, paint or thrown ink; beyond Touch a model, picture or Arcane Connection carries the mark). The ward is a subset of one Form, narrowed by shape or material, or one being through an Arcane Connection. Ward levels against natural things: Animal 5; Aquam 20; Auram 10/15/20/25 by weather severity; Corpus 30; Herbam 30; Ignem 15 to 40 by the fire's damage; Terram 20 dirt, 25 stone or glass, 30 metal or gems; the general guideline wards beings of one realm and Form with Might up to the level.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw.

casting.name: Warding
casting.vis: pawns of an Art fitting the effect, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: An Accelerated Ability: its equivalent spell level is the Casting Total, not 5 x score. Always Touch/Ring/Circle, the circle drawn as for a Hermetic one. Against natural things the Warding Total must reach the ward guideline's level. Against a being with Might, Warding Total + Penetration bonus (Penetration worked out as for a level-0 spell) must reach its Might; an Arcane Connection raises the multiplier. It cannot keep out anything with Magic Resistance but no Might (magi, the faithful): its Penetration against them is 0.
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level to enchant the circle

advancement.notes: Warding is an Accelerated Ability: it advances on the Art table, but is not studied from vis and gains only +1 a pawn of vis.

entries.name: Donatores Requietis Aeternae
entries.description: Ghost-layers of House Ex Miscellanea who loudly banish every spirit of a named realm from a place, and cannot cast on consecrated ground.
entries.notes: Package: Banishing (Major Supernatural, an Accelerated Ability), a Minor Magical Focus (Mentem spirits and ghosts, or Corpus animated dead), Restriction (no casting on consecrated ground). All learn Penetration. The book says the Donatores' Banishing is Divine, yet its own example has Magic-aligned Banishing; the realm is set to Divine here, but a member's Banishing may be another realm. A banished creature may try to come back: Stamina + its realm's Lore against 12 (the aura's realm interaction changes the 12); if it gets in, its Might is cut by half the Banishing score while inside, and it suffers. Divine beings doing God's work are immune. Common choices: Ghostly Warder, Sense Holiness and Unholiness, True Faith, Relic, Second Sight; Plagued by Supernatural Entity, Higher Purpose, Compulsion, Nocturnal, Visions.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw. Every Donator learns Penetration.

casting.name: Banishing
casting.vis: pawns of an Art fitting the effect, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: An Accelerated Ability: its equivalent spell level is the Casting Total, not 5 x score. A loud command to everything of one named realm to leave; naming the wrong realm fails. Ease Factor by area, the caster inside it: Near (10 paces) 3, Structure 6, Boundary 9. Penetration = Banishing Total - Ease Factor + Penetration bonus (Arcane Connections multiply). What penetrates is banished for Sun, friendly beings too unless the target's True Name is used. Every user present learns the power's source.
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level

advancement.notes: Banishing is an Accelerated Ability: Art table, no study from vis, +1 a pawn of vis.

entries.name: Pharmacopoeians
entries.description: Healers descended from the herbalist Crateuas, the Root-Cutters, who brew healing draughts, poisons and tonics, and swear to preserve life.
entries.notes: Package: Mythic Herbalism, Root-Cutter, Deficient Technique (Perdo), and a Minor Magical Focus (Healing), with one of Soft-Hearted, Noncombatant or Vow (Pacifism). All have some Medicine, Chirurgy or Profession: Apothecary. Common choices: Puissant or Affinity with Creo, Corpus or Mythic Herbalism; Cyclic Magic (seasons); Purifying Touch. Brewing needs no lab, takes Ease Factor / 3 days, +1 Ease Factor per extra dose (+3 for a contact poison); products spoil after a season. The Ease Factor table (3 to 24) sets what a healing draught, poison or physical tonic does.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw; one of Soft-Hearted, Noncombatant or Vow (Pacifism) is also required.

casting.name: Mythic Herbalism
casting.notes: Brewing, not casting: a failure is useless and a botch may poison the maker or the drinker. A poison's victim resists against the table's resistance number. Healing poultices last a month; tonics last Sun and do not stack.

advancement.notes: A Supernatural Ability on the Ability table; the Virtue gives it at 1.

entries.name: Lineage of Pralix
entries.description: Magi who study and preserve other hedge traditions and bring them into the Order. Their Comprehend Magic lets them see and analyse any magic they meet.
entries.notes: Package: Comprehend Magic, a Minor Magical Focus (Exotic Magic: non-Hermetic Magic-realm magic, not creature powers), Weak Magic Resistance against any caster not yet studied with Comprehend Magic. Pralicians induct hedge wizards: a short apprenticeship (under 5 years) in Magic Theory and the Order's customs, an optional Opening (a Pralician opener needs no Art at 5 and the Code doesn't punish the Deficiencies that result; an opened wizard almost always gains a Major Hermetic Flaw), at least a season teaching Parma Magica, then the Oath and Hermetic Magus. An unopened wizard joins as a Gifted Companion. In joint training each season of Hermetic teaching earns two seasons of the apprentice's lab help. Probing another magus beyond 'is he a magus' is scrying under the Code.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw.

casting.name: Comprehend Magic
casting.notes: Ease Factor by source: magus 12 - magnitude of his highest Art; Supernatural Virtue 15 - its Ability (-3 more if Gifted; a Virtue with no Ability counts 3 Minor, 5 Major); creature 15 - Might magnitude; spell or spell-like power 18 - its magnitude; Supernatural power 18 - Might points spent; enchanted item 18 - strongest power's magnitude; aura 12 - its level; vis 9 - pawns. Success shows magic is there; each further round of Concentration adds its type, then its function or Form, then its magnitude, and anything beyond presence must penetrate. After three rounds: +2 x Comprehend Magic to spontaneous Muto, Perdo or Rego Vim spells against that one creature or magic. It also does everything Magic Sensitivity does, without the Magic Resistance penalty.

advancement.notes: A Supernatural Ability on the Ability table; the Virtue gives it at 1. Investigating an enchantment, Magic Theory x Comprehend Magic replaces Magic Theory in the Lab Total.

entries.name: Rustic Magi (Rusticani)
entries.description: Craftsman magi who cast by making things: each spell is worked into an object of their craft, and they can make charged items in days instead of a season.
entries.notes: Package: Craft Magic (Major Supernatural), Spell Foci, Weak Spontaneous Magic (never spends Fatigue on spontaneous magic). Craft Magic needs a Craft or Profession score and another source of magic (Arts or a Supernatural Virtue), and uses a workshop, not a lab. Crafted casting: the object takes the place of words and gestures, takes at least the time of a Ritual of that level, must be brought into range, and keeps no magic; a stress die only checks for a botch. The object's shape and material bonuses add, up to the Craft score. Charged items without a season: one craft-time per item, the Casting Total as the Lab Total (Magi of Hermes' weaver makes one one-charge sheet a day). Lesser enchantment of an object already holding vis: the Casting Total replaces the Lab Total (an invested Supernatural Ability need only equal the level), level at most 5 x pawns in it. Joining House Verditius strips the Virtue.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw, and a Craft or Profession score.

casting.name: Craft Magic (no Hermetic equivalent)
casting.notes: For a power with no Hermetic or Supernatural roll, Dexterity + the relevant Craft + a die stands for the Casting Total (base level 5). Otherwise Craft Magic uses the Hermetic Casting Total or the Supernatural Ability's roll, plus the object's shape and material bonuses up to the Craft score.

advancement.notes: Craft Magic has no Ability of its own: it works through the character's Craft or Profession score.

entries.name: Hermetic Sahirs
entries.description: Muslim magi of Iberia who summon jinn and bind them by bargain to serve for a time.
entries.notes: Package: Sihr (an Accelerated Ability), a Minor Magical Focus (jinn only), Twilight Prone. Common choices: Second Sight, Elementalist Virtues, Student of (Realm), Puissant or Affinity with Bargain; Judged Unfairly, Feud (House Flambeau). Discern first: with Second Sight one round, else Intelligence + Area Lore against 6 (about an hour), then Intelligence + the jinni's realm Lore + a stress die against 9 for its Might magnitude. Summoning vis: a fitting Form, 1 pawn per magnitude of Might as standard (at least 1, at most the Sihr score). Each extra 15 minutes of summoning: +2 Penetration, +1 botch die, -1 Fatigue level afterwards. Duties he accepts and their breach, and botches (Supernatural Nuisance or Plagued by Jinni), are story matters.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw.

casting.name: Summon a jinni
casting.vis: vis of a Form fitting the jinni, for the bargain (it does not add to the summoning)
casting.notes: An Accelerated Ability: its equivalent spell level is the Casting Total, not 5 x score. At least 15 minutes, at the jinni's home (an Arcane Connection, +1 multiplier) or in its presence. The Ease Factor is the jinni's Might; the Penetration Total (Summoning Total + Penetration bonus - Might) must reach its Might. Summoning Strength = Summoning Total - Might, added to the bargain.

casting.name: Bargain with a jinni
casting.notes: Adds the Summoning Strength (only for a jinni he summoned). Ease Factor 18 + scope (general +3, specific 0, single task -3) + term (day -3, week 0, month +3, season +6, year +9) + duty he accepts (simple -3, onerous -6) + vis (+2 per pawn below the standard, -2 per pawn above). Failure: no bargain; botch: an angry jinni.

bonds.name: Bound jinni
bonds.how: Summon it with Sihr and strike a bargain; it serves until it spends its last Might point for him, or he fails his duty.
bonds.feeds: After serving a season it may teach Sihr, its Form or its realm Lore at Source Quality 3 x its Might magnitude, once each.
bonds.notes: He may keep as many jinn in service as his Leadership (at least 1). A jinni keeps oaths sworn before the summons and swears no new ones without his leave.

advancement.notes: Sihr is an Accelerated Ability: Art table, no study from vis, +1 a pawn of vis. A serving jinni can teach it.

entries.name: Seirenes
entries.description: A women's tradition of singing magae whose songs command those who hear them; every spell they cast is sung.
entries.notes: Package: Siren Song (Major non-Hermetic), a Minor Magical Focus (Mentem, one emotion), Necessary Condition (every spell sung, never silent; no Quiet Magic). Female apprentices only; the tradition also takes unGifted women, and women with a damaged Gift, who have Supernatural Abilities and can learn Siren Song (equals in the tradition, but no vote in the Order). Up to two other musicians may add their Music, each capped at the singer's. With Enchanting Music she must beat the target's Stamina on both rolls, and then the command may outlast the song. Common choices: Free Expression, Inspirational, Puissant Music, Performance Magic, Skilled Parens, Well-Traveled, Social Contacts.

training.notes: A Hermetic maga of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw; apprentices are trained in Music and Siren Song.

casting.name: Siren Song
casting.resistance: The target's Stamina roll + the command's bonus: innocuous +0, questionable +3, dangerous +6, heinous +9, suicidal +12.
casting.notes: One command to everyone who hears; it lasts while she makes music, and a new roll changes it. The command needn't be in the lyrics. Up to two helpers add their Music, each capped at hers.

advancement.notes: Siren Song has no Ability score of its own: the Virtue grants the power and Music is rolled.

entries.name: Hermetic Sorginak
entries.description: A few Basque magi descended from a coven that worked with two Bonisagus brothers. Each keeps one sorgina power, and casts Hermetic spells with potions, Euskara incantations and fetishes.
entries.notes: Package: one Major sorginak power chosen from Healing (vf_healing), Hex (vf_hex), Shapeshifter (vf_shapeshifter) or the Goetic Art Summoning (vf_summoning), plus Exotic Casting and Necessary Condition (potions, Euskara incantations and fetishes). Summoning is a Goetic Art and has no Ability record here, so it is left out of the Abilities. Hex is re-aligned to Magic but still Infernally tainted (seen only by Divine or Infernal detection). Exotic Casting: the Form of his spells is identified against a flat Ease Factor 15. Favoured Tribunals: Provençal, Iberia, a few in Normandy.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea who takes one of Healing, Hex, Shapeshifter or Summoning as the free Major non-Hermetic Virtue.

casting.name: Sorgina power
casting.vis: pawns of an Art fitting the effect, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: Worked by Potion, Euskara Incantation or Fetish, which she must also use for her Hermetic spells.

casting.name: Hex
casting.vis: Vim vis, up to the Ability score; each pawn adds a botch die
casting.notes: Ease Factor = severity (minor 6, serious 12, major 18, critical 24, terminal 30) + duration or lifting condition (momentary 0 to year or ultimate condition +15, in steps of 3) + delay (moment +12 down to lifetime -12). Incantation: eye contact or touch, and the target hears it. A fetish holding an Arcane Connection takes a season to make and is used once from any distance; fetish and incantation together give +1 Penetration multiplier.

advancement.notes: The sorgina power is a Supernatural Ability on the Ability table.

entries.name: Gorgiastic Cathars
entries.description: A handful of Provençal magi, a theurgic Cathar mystery cult descended from House Criamon. Each has a tutelary spirit, a Genius, and seeks Twilight as an escape from eternal recurrence.
entries.notes: Package: Ghostly Warder (their Genius, taken as the Major non-Hermetic Virtue), Quiet Magic, Twilight Prone. No Enigmatic Wisdom: Organization Lore: Gorgiastic Cathars serves as their Theology too. They count their faith as Magic, using magic to reach God. Founded by Anais of Toulouse, expelled from House Criamon; joined Ex Miscellanea in 975.

training.notes: A Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea, with the tradition's free Virtues and compulsory Flaw.

entries.name: Sahirs (Suhhar Sulayman)
entries.description: The sahirs of the Islamic lands, who summon a spirit (usually a jinni with Sihr) and cast through it with five Solomonic arts: Alchemy, Astrology, Physic, Storytelling and Travel. Gifted or unGifted, they belong to the Suhhar Sulayman and its houses of wisdom.

training.notes: 45 xp for the first five years, then 15 xp a year (Wealthy 20, Poor 10) until he joins, 25 xp a year after (Wealthy 30, Poor 15). A Gifted sahir with a summoning Virtue may start initiated by a Gifted sahir into all five arts at 0, with a free Minor Virtue from the teacher (usually Puissant in the family's art). Spells cost xp equal to their level, at most Int + summoning art + Solomonic art + related Ability; a starter should have 120 spell levels or more, a summoning art able to call a Might 10 spirit and 5 in one Solomonic art. Each lab season at creation costs 10 xp (at most his free seasons a year).

casting.name: Summoning
casting.vis: the jinni's Form (+1 a pawn of any other Art); the customary offering is separate and changes only the bargain
casting.notes: Ease Factor = the spirit's Might Score; at least 15 minutes. Summoning Strength = total - Might Score, and adds to every naranj and Lab Total through that spirit. Each extra 15 minutes: +5 Penetration, +1 botch die, a long-term Fatigue level. A learned summoning spell rolls the same with no Fatigue and no vis, and its True Name adds +5 to the Penetration multiplier. Bargaining: Com + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die vs 18 + terms. The Gift's penalty applies to the bargain.

casting.name: Naranj
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level per 5 levels short; the spell still works unless that knocks him unconscious
casting.vis: fitting the effect; a Ritual costs 1 pawn a magnitude, within the art's score
casting.notes: Adds the Summoning Strength of the spirit it is cast through (not a score). Disguised as mundane work it adds the art's associated Ability and takes 15 minutes a magnitude. Penetration is the spirit's: its Might + its Penetration + its aura modifier - the spell level. A shortfall also lowers that Summoning Strength by the amount. The margin of 20 assumes a fresh caster (4 Fatigue levels before unconsciousness); the book's rounding of 'per 5 levels' is unstated. UnGifted: level no higher than the spirit's Might. A botch: 1 Warping Point per 0.

casting.name: Solomonic Alchemy Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Astrology Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Physic Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Storytelling Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Travel Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3. Travel adds the Lore of the effect's realm (score 3 or more).

casting.name: Al-Iksir
casting.notes: His highest Solomonic art + Medicine + Summoning Strength + aura; vis = total / 5 pawns; gives total / 5 Al-Iksir Points to spend on benefits, and as many on drawbacks.

Solomonic Alchemy.against: damage (also -bonus to Aging rolls and +bonus to Strength for loads)

Solomonic Physic.against: attacks while he is not attacking (also Recovery, Aging and stealth rolls)

opening.notes: The teacher's Travel + Magic Lore Lab Total, halved; a season with a spirit the teacher summoned, and the student must have a summoning art. It opens all five arts at 0. Against non-Solomonic Supernatural Abilities: EF = 2 x their sum, +10 if the Gift was already Opened. Each art in which the teacher has less than 5 gives the student Deficient Technique in it (threshold 5, not the usual 2, so the Flaw is left to the troupe). UnGifted or already-Opened students take the journey instead: Opening Total 30 gives a Major Virtue the teacher has, 25 that and a Minor Flaw, 15 that and a Major Flaw; vis 15 / 12 / 7 pawns, and the spirit loses as much Might; 2 Warping Points.

advancement.notes: Sihr and the Solomonic arts are Accelerated (Art table). A jinni coerced for a season teaches a Form, Sihr or its Realm Lore as a tractatus of Quality 3 x its Might magnitude, once per subject.

activities.label: Invent a naranj
activities.summary: A season with a summoned spirit: accumulate Lab Total - level toward a formulaic or Ritual spell's level.

activities.label: Invent a summoning spell
activities.summary: A season of Astrology + Artes Liberales: a summoning spell of level = the spirit's Might (level 5 if its True Name is known).

activities.label: Extract, remove or move vis
activities.summary: A season of Alchemy + Philosophiae: Lab Total / 10 pawns from an aura, / 5 from a being or item, or / 2 between objects.

activities.label: Seek or scour a spirit
activities.summary: A season of Storytelling + Area Lore: find a spirit of Might up to the Lab Total, or hold one captive of up to half.

activities.label: Ward a circle or object
activities.summary: A season of Travel + (Realm) Lore and a pawn of Vim: spirits of his summoning art's realm up to the Lab Total cannot cross it.

activities.label: Bond a khadim
activities.summary: A season: bind a willing spirit as a servant khadim, gaining Bond Points.

activities.label: Brew Al-Iksir
activities.summary: A season: the elixir of life, giving Al-Iksir Points.

activities.label: Open a student
activities.summary: A season with a spirit: Travel + Magic Lore Lab Total / 2 Opens a Gifted student to all five arts, or carries an unGifted one into the Magic Realm.

bonds.name: Bargained jinni
bonds.how: Summoned, then bound by a bargain for a term of service (Com + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die vs 18 + terms).
bonds.feeds: Any task in its power for the term; a jinni coerced for a whole season teaches as a tractatus of Quality 3 x its Might magnitude.
bonds.notes: At most Leadership + 1 jinn bound at once.

bonds.name: Khadim
bonds.how: A season: the highest art + (Realm) Lore Lab Total must reach the willing spirit's Might; vis of its Form equal to its Might magnitude.
bonds.feeds: Bond Points equal to its Might magnitude, bought on a pyramid (level n costs n(n+1)/2): each level gives -1 botch die (Safety), +2 Casting Total, +3 Finesse, +2 Concentration, or +5 to the spirit's Penetration.
bonds.notes: A spirit bonds with one sahir; a sahir may bond several. Repeating the season only moves the points.

bonds.name: Greater binding
bonds.how: Open an object with Vim vis (Alchemy + Philosophiae, at most Alchemy pawns a season; a literal container doubles its space and gives +5), then bind spirit and effect with art + Philosophiae, accumulating total - level.
bonds.feeds: A triggered effect; a Ritual effect costs the spirit 1 Might Point a magnitude.
bonds.notes: The Suhhar forbids it for intelligent spirits. The binding is an Arcane Connection to the spirit; breaking the object frees it.

warping.name: Fatra Bayna
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from a magical botch.
warping.notes: Avoid: stress die + Sta + Concentration + Travel bonus vs stress die + Warping Score + Warping Points gained + aura. If not: every summoned spirit goes free and his rituals end. Duration by a secret simple die (+/-3 a Confidence Point, +/- the Travel bonus): 1 or less Diameter (+3 Corruption), 2-4 Sun (+2), 5-7 Moon (+1), 8-9 Season (+1 Spirit), 10+ Year (+3 Spirit); he gains Warping Points equal to the modified roll, and each rise in Warping Score banks a Corruption Point. The storyguide spends Spirit Points on xp, naranjs, vis or Confidence, and Corruption Points on aging, wounds, bad Reputation or Flaws. A typical sahir gains 2 Warping Points a year.

entries.notes: Every sahir should have Sihr or another summoning Virtue: Sihr, (Spirit) Summoning, elementalist Summoning, the Iberian Sihr, or (Faerie) Summoning (yatus); one who cannot summon takes Dark Secret. Vizier is a Minor Status for Majlis members. Casting needs 4 in Arabic, Parsi or Greek; reading needs 5 and Artes Liberales 1. Each starter knows one focus spirit and holds an Arcane Connection to it. Group lab work: one leader with Leadership of at least the other participants, each adding Int + Ability, the highest art used; 10 days' absence each are free. Effects use the Hermetic level scale; each art's guideline table is not transcribed. Magical Defenses are art / 5 (rounding unstated); Astrology (Initiative, alert Perception, experiments), Storytelling (social rolls, Leadership over spirits, resisting emotion powers) and Travel (navigation, Fatra Bayna rolls, Stamina, resisting influence) have no matching defense kind. Bismillah: Arabic 6+ and Com + Theology: Islam + stress die vs 6 makes one untouchable by a Faerie or Infernal jinni until the next prayer. Spontaneous Solomonic Spells, Independent Solomonic Magic and the other breakthrough Virtues are research goals, not listed.

entries.name: Nizari Mustajibs
entries.description: Renegade sahirs of the Nizari Isma'ilis, who summon only with Sihr and favour Solomonic Storytelling. Gifted mustajibs are Opened to every art; the unGifted are initiated at Alamut.

training.notes: 45 xp for the first five years, then 15 xp a year (Wealthy 20, Poor 10) until he joins, 25 xp a year after (Wealthy 30, Poor 15). A Gifted sahir with a summoning Virtue may start initiated by a Gifted sahir into all five arts at 0, with a free Minor Virtue from the teacher (usually Puissant in the family's art). Spells cost xp equal to their level, at most Int + summoning art + Solomonic art + related Ability; a starter should have 120 spell levels or more, a summoning art able to call a Might 10 spirit and 5 in one Solomonic art. Each lab season at creation costs 10 xp (at most his free seasons a year).

casting.name: Summoning
casting.vis: the jinni's Form (+1 a pawn of any other Art); the customary offering is separate and changes only the bargain
casting.notes: Ease Factor = the spirit's Might Score; at least 15 minutes. Summoning Strength = total - Might Score, and adds to every naranj and Lab Total through that spirit. Each extra 15 minutes: +5 Penetration, +1 botch die, a long-term Fatigue level. A learned summoning spell rolls the same with no Fatigue and no vis, and its True Name adds +5 to the Penetration multiplier. Bargaining: Com + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die vs 18 + terms. The Gift's penalty applies to the bargain.

casting.name: Naranj
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level per 5 levels short; the spell still works unless that knocks him unconscious
casting.vis: fitting the effect; a Ritual costs 1 pawn a magnitude, within the art's score
casting.notes: Adds the Summoning Strength of the spirit it is cast through (not a score). Disguised as mundane work it adds the art's associated Ability and takes 15 minutes a magnitude. Penetration is the spirit's: its Might + its Penetration + its aura modifier - the spell level. A shortfall also lowers that Summoning Strength by the amount. The margin of 20 assumes a fresh caster (4 Fatigue levels before unconsciousness); the book's rounding of 'per 5 levels' is unstated. UnGifted: level no higher than the spirit's Might. A botch: 1 Warping Point per 0.

casting.name: Solomonic Alchemy Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Astrology Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Physic Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Storytelling Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3.

casting.name: Solomonic Travel Lab Total
casting.notes: Adds the spirit's Summoning Strength; the spirit stays all season. UnGifted: effect level no higher than the spirit's Might. A lab set up by someone with the associated Ability below 3 gives -3. Travel adds the Lore of the effect's realm (score 3 or more).

casting.name: Al-Iksir
casting.notes: His highest Solomonic art + Medicine + Summoning Strength + aura; vis = total / 5 pawns; gives total / 5 Al-Iksir Points to spend on benefits, and as many on drawbacks.

Solomonic Alchemy.against: damage (also -bonus to Aging rolls and +bonus to Strength for loads)

Solomonic Physic.against: attacks while he is not attacking (also Recovery, Aging and stealth rolls)

opening.notes: The teacher's Travel + Magic Lore Lab Total, halved; a season with a spirit the teacher summoned, and the student must have a summoning art. It opens all five arts at 0. Against non-Solomonic Supernatural Abilities: EF = 2 x their sum, +10 if the Gift was already Opened. Each art in which the teacher has less than 5 gives the student Deficient Technique in it (threshold 5, not the usual 2, so the Flaw is left to the troupe). UnGifted or already-Opened students take the journey instead: Opening Total 30 gives a Major Virtue the teacher has, 25 that and a Minor Flaw, 15 that and a Major Flaw; vis 15 / 12 / 7 pawns, and the spirit loses as much Might; 2 Warping Points.

advancement.notes: Sihr and the Solomonic arts are Accelerated (Art table). A jinni coerced for a season teaches a Form, Sihr or its Realm Lore as a tractatus of Quality 3 x its Might magnitude, once per subject.

activities.label: Invent a naranj
activities.summary: A season with a summoned spirit: accumulate Lab Total - level toward a formulaic or Ritual spell's level.

activities.label: Invent a summoning spell
activities.summary: A season of Astrology + Artes Liberales: a summoning spell of level = the spirit's Might (level 5 if its True Name is known).

activities.label: Extract, remove or move vis
activities.summary: A season of Alchemy + Philosophiae: Lab Total / 10 pawns from an aura, / 5 from a being or item, or / 2 between objects.

activities.label: Seek or scour a spirit
activities.summary: A season of Storytelling + Area Lore: find a spirit of Might up to the Lab Total, or hold one captive of up to half.

activities.label: Ward a circle or object
activities.summary: A season of Travel + (Realm) Lore and a pawn of Vim: spirits of his summoning art's realm up to the Lab Total cannot cross it.

activities.label: Bond a khadim
activities.summary: A season: bind a willing spirit as a servant khadim, gaining Bond Points.

activities.label: Brew Al-Iksir
activities.summary: A season: the elixir of life, giving Al-Iksir Points.
